item.tib: yi dam 'jigs byed kyi khrid rim zhal gdams chen mo
item.coloph: zhes pa 'di'ang rig 'dzin gyi slob dpon chen po bla ma dran pa nam mkha'i zhal gyi gdams pa/ dbang chen tshal gyi brag phug tu gter du sbas/ rten 'brel nges 'byung kyi (gi)brda sgo phyes nas spyan drangs te/ rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis gtan la dbab pa'i yi ge pa ni drung yig a yu rdor dzas bgyis pa dge tshogs gshen bstan rgyas pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
